intake.engagement_type: Generative AI solution build (pilot to production)
intake.problem_statement: Claims intake agents re-key about 18,000 first notice of loss (FNOL) reports per month from phone, e-mail and web forms into Guidewire ClaimCenter. Average handling time is 22 minutes per FNOL, 9% of new claims need rework, and storm peaks (3x volume) create a 2-day backlog.
goals: Reduce average FNOL handling time from 22 minutes to under 8 minutes
Reduce claim rework from 9% to under 3%
Reach at least 95% field extraction accuracy on 500 historical FNOLs
Absorb 3x storm-peak volumes without a backlog
constraints: Human approval before any claim is created in ClaimCenter
All data stays in the US (us-east-2)
SOC 2 Type II controls; no customer data used for model training
Single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID

findings: FNOLs arrive 55% by phone (transcribed by the contact centre), 30% by e-mail and 15% by web form
Attachments: police reports (PDF), repair estimates (PDF/Word), up to 10 photos per claim
Guidewire ClaimCenter 10 exposes REST APIs for draft claim creation (Cloud API)
Policy wording: about 1,400 PDF documents across 6 product lines, updated quarterly
Spanish is used in about 18% of FNOLs
requirements: Extract 32 FNOL fields with a confidence score per field
Coverage check with citations to the policy wording
Draft follow-up e-mail for missing information (English and Spanish)
Supervisor dashboard: volume, handling time, extraction accuracy, approval rate
discovery.notes: Pilot with the auto claims team (40 intake agents) before home claims.
